final: SELECT AVG(g.avg_press) AS avg_pressratio_of_groups, AVG(g.avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_min_of_groups FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) g
